name: Germania
beschreibung: The Hotel Germania is located in a municipality in Tirol. The accommodation offers several rooms with a view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The furnishings are practical and tailored to guests' needs. The property has a breakfast room and a lounge area. Hiking trails and ski areas can be reached from here. The hotel is open all year round and is aimed at those seeking relaxation. There are sufficient parking spaces. The surrounding area invites outdoor activities.
